# components/timepicker

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.ts from components/timepicker/timepicker.ts — edit the source, then `deno task docs`. -->

Import: `import { timeToMinutes, minutesToTime, timeSlots, TimePicker } from "@tundralibs/ui/timepicker"`

Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `timeToMinutes`

```ts
timeToMinutes(value?: string): number | undefined
```

`"09:30"` → 570, anything that is not ISO `HH:MM` → undefined.

### `minutesToTime`

```ts
minutesToTime(total: number): string
```

570 → `"09:30"` (wraps into one day).

### `timeSlots`

```ts
timeSlots(step = …: number, min?: string, max?: string): string[]
```

The slots the popover offers: every `step` minutes from midnight, inside `min`–`max`.

### `TimePicker`

```ts
TimePicker(props: TimePickerProps): Html
```

A 24-hour time: two typeable segments (hours, minutes) and a popover of
slots every `step` minutes. Keyboard first — digits fill a segment and
jump to the next, ↑/↓ step it, PageUp/PageDown move by `step`, `:`
jumps to minutes, Alt+↓ opens the slots (where ↑/↓, Home/End and typed
digits move, Enter picks). The value posts as ISO `HH:MM` under `name`.

Progressive: the markup's value input is a native `<input type="time">`
carrying `name`, `min`, `max` and `required`, which is what a no-JS page
shows and submits; timepicker.js turns it into a hidden input and keeps
it in step with the segments, and reports `required` / `min` / `max`
as a custom validity on the hours segment so `Form({ validate: true })`
shows it in the field's error slot. The server must check them too.

## Types

### `TimePickerMessages`

Messages the picker reports (through the validator, or the browser's bubble) instead of its defaults.

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `required` | `string` |  | `required` and nothing entered. Default "Enter a time." |
| `incomplete` | `string` |  | Hours without minutes, or the other way round. Default "Enter hours and minutes." |
| `min` | `string` |  | Before `min`. Default "Pick {min} or later." |
| `max` | `string` |  | After `max`. Default "Pick {max} or earlier." |

### `TimePickerProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Required: goes on the hours segment (so a label's `for` reaches it); the minutes segment, the slot list and the value input derive theirs from it (`<id>-minute`, `<id>-list`, `<id>-value`). |
| `name` | `string` | yes | The hidden input that posts the value as ISO `HH:MM` (24-hour). |
| `value` | `string` |  | ISO `HH:MM`, 24-hour. Anything else renders empty. |
| `step` | `number` |  | Minutes between the slots in the popover (default 15). Typing and the arrow keys still reach any minute. |
| `min` | `string` |  | Earliest time accepted, ISO `HH:MM`; earlier slots are not offered. |
| `max` | `string` |  | Latest time accepted, ISO `HH:MM`. |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Paint the error state (a server-side `RapidFormError` for this field). |
| `zone` | `string` |  | A chip after the value naming the zone the time is in (`"UTC"`). Text only — it converts nothing. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name for the whole control when no `<label for>` points at it. |
| `align` | `"start" | "end"` |  | Which edge of the field the slot list aligns to. |
| `messages` | `TimePickerMessages` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  | Extra attributes for the root (a caller's `class` is merged). |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A time in a form field

Posts `HH:MM` under `name`; without JS it is a native `<input type="time">`. `Input({ type: "time" })` renders this too.

```ts
FormField({
  id: "pickup",
  label: "Pickup",
  help: "Between 08:00 and 18:00.",
  control: (a) =>
    TimePicker({
      id: a.id,
      name: "pickup",
      value: "09:30",
      min: "08:00",
      max: "18:00",
      step: 30,
      required: true,
    }),
})
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/timepicker/timepicker.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.input`, `.js`, `.timepicker`, `.timepicker--disabled`, `.timepicker--end`, `.timepicker--invalid`, `.timepicker--open`, `.timepicker__check`, `.timepicker__field`, `.timepicker__icon`, `.timepicker__list`, `.timepicker__native`, `.timepicker__segment`, `.timepicker__segment--invalid`, `.timepicker__sep`, `.timepicker__slot`, `.timepicker__toggle`, `.timepicker__zone`

## Behaviour

`components/timepicker/timepicker.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-active`, `data-msg-`, `data-segment`, `data-step`, `data-timepicker`, `data-timepicker-error`, `data-timepicker-max`, `data-timepicker-min`, `data-timepicker-required`, `data-timepicker-toggle`, `data-timepicker-value`, `data-validate`, `data-validate-skip`, `data-value`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`, `timepicker:refresh`.
